claim.purpose: Make the ADL Google Drive context mirror work and verify content end to end

initial.title: [v0.91.8][google-workspace][automation] Make ADL Drive context mirror work end to end
initial.goal: Run the ADL context mirror against Google Drive with recursive, content-verified, least-privilege behavior.
initial.required_outcome: Execute mode uses the native Drive transport, mirrors the declared repository surfaces recursively, and succeeds only after exact remote-content readback.
authority_boundary: Issue #5587 owns production Drive mirror behavior and its focused proof
Remote deletion and broader Workspace access are excluded
initial.task_boundary: Correct transport selection, recursive traversal, exact readback verification, and success-only automation semantics.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: execute mode performs a real Drive create or update and exact readback verification
AC-2: docs and .adl/docs/TBD Markdown trees mirror recursively with preserved relative paths
AC-3: least-privilege scopes and explicit write approval remain enforced
AC-4: automation archives only fully verified successes and retains deduplicated failures
AC-5: fixture and focused tests prove deterministic success and fail-closed behavior
dependencies: Google Drive credentials and configured root folder
initial.plan_summary: Implement native execution and exact readback, add recursive mirroring, validate locally and live, then review and publish through typed v2.

steps.action: Implement native execute transport and exact content verification
Implement recursive path-preserving Markdown mirroring and automation result semantics
Run focused and live proof, review, publish, and close out

risks: Remote write targets the wrong folder
review_prompts: Can execute mode still select an in-memory transport?
Can a successful report be emitted without exact readback?

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove native contract, exact readback, approval, and failure behavior
Prove recursive path preservation and truthful reporting

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on missing approval, credentials, path escape, ambiguous remote children, API failure, or content mismatch.
